thread:
morgan: Heads-up: external assessor asked for a dry-run of evidence packaging + retest info before the main window. Can we validate everything next week?
priya: Yup. Dry-run checklist: RBAC snapshot, presigned bundle, audit export, runtime traces, KMS ephemeral role. Keep it < 10MB where possible.
ingrid: Audit note: need to redact user email hashes for privacy, but keep request_id and resource paths. Assessor needs raw event ordering.
james: For KMS, we can provision an ephemeral role that only allows "Decrypt" for test keys and uses a key-wrapping alias. TTL 4h for dry-run.
alex: Is there a standard naming convention for presigned bundles? Last time we used evidence-<engagement>-<ts>.zip but assessor wants separate objects for cloudtrail.json and runtime-traces.tar.gz.
priya: Use: evidence-assess-175432-dryrun/cloudtrail.json and evidence-assess-175432-dryrun/runtime-traces.tar.gz. I'll generate a README.md in the bundle describing fields and redaction.
morgan: Good. Ops: can we do a short retest booking step now? If the assessor finds high-sev, we want a guaranteed retest slot within 3 business days.
ops-oncall: We can reserve a morning slot Mon/Tue next week; ops will block capacity and flag to infra. Also we'll enforce credential rotation immediately after any external access.
ingrid: Triage process suggestion: create a triage column in vuln board called "Assessor validation" and assign items to a rotating SRE+Security owner. SLA: acknowledge in 8h, initial triage in 24h, patch ETA in 5 days for sev>=P2.
james: Agree. Add an "evidence accepted" checklist for each finding so the assessor can mark it verified. We'll record verification time in the ticket.
priya: Commands I'm going to run for snapshot/diff (dry-run):
```
./tools/rbac-snapshot --out /tmp/rbac-dryrun-175432.json
./tools/rbac-diff /tmp/rbac-prev.json /tmp/rbac-dryrun-175432.json --exclude ci-* > /tmp/rbac-diff.txt
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-dryrun-175432.json gs://evidence-exports/assessments/175432-dryrun-rbac.json
```
alex: For traces: keep two short samples (startup + steady-state). Put them into runtime-traces.tar.gz and include a manifest with md5s.
morgan: Security-bot, please open a ticket and enforce the checklist and retest reservation step.

priya: Proposed dry-run: Wed 2026-02-18 14:00 UTC. Main window: Fri 2026-02-20 16:00 UTC, 6h. Retest hold: Mon 2026-02-23 09:00-12:00 UTC.
ops-oncall: Holds set. I'll patch ops-calendar and post in #oncall. We'll also run credential rotation playbook immediately after any access window.

morgan: Final: priya posts the presigned URLs + ephemeral_role_arn in this thread after dry-run. Keep the bundle minimal, add README. After main window ops rotates creds and closes the presigned URLs.
